experiments.description: Fill unused ordinary result slots with complete conjunctive identifier matches; retain ordinary ranks.
If direct lexical supplementation changes incumbent hybrid ranks, keep supplementary symbols outside reciprocal-rank fusion and append them after the incumbent hybrid result.

guards: Never lose a delivered fact or worsen its rank, including each previously supplied member of a composed answer.
Negatives keep exactly the same returned record IDs; no increased noise, project leak, caller exclusion, verification/tag violation or packet overrun.
Replay all earlier corpora under lexical and hybrid plus diagnostic hybrid policies.
Use a fixed eight-result, 1000-token budget; do not change claim text, thresholds, model weights, or release assets after seeing results.
Full-pool failures remain visible; do not discard hard categories to achieve 100%. Select on development before scoring the fixed heldout candidate.

amendments.reason: The broad append prototype improved development recall but failed the pre-existing exact-literal/file lookup contract. Preserve that test and restrict supplementation rather than weakening it.

additional_experiment.description: Append complete symbol matches only with free slots, no explicit file context and no existing title equal to the task or failure. Keep incumbent order and all prior contracts.

registration_serialization: JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2) plus a final newline
